cohort: Eighty women with a confirmed diagnosis of preeclampsia, who had angiogenic markers measured at a median gestational age of 30 weeks.
finding: Angiogenic markers (sFlt-1, PlGF, or sFlt-1/PlGF ratio) measured during pregnancy were not significantly associated with the prediction of hypertension 1 year postpartum.
gest_age: Median 30 (interquartile range 27-33) weeks at biomarker measurement
